name: Generate personalized prayers, affirmations, and motivational messages
description: Users requested the generation of prayers, positive affirmations, motivational messages, and supportive responses tailored for various recipients and situations such as exams, personal struggles, family well-being, or general encouragement. The requests often specified the target audience (e.g., a coworker, a friend, a girlfriend) or the specific emotional context (e.g., depression, achievement, stress), with some including requests for shared personal milestones or compliments to be given to the user themselves.
